$comment: source: §4.3 TransitionIntent / AdA montage shot_transition. L2 is tool-neutral: no model names, software names, node graphs, plugin names, or vendor parameter names. Enums are L0 concept_id strings. Numeric fields need unit + measurement_basis. Time intervals are half-open OTIO [start,end). Versions must not be the string latest.
title: TransitionIntent

boundary_constraints.$comment: 4.3 row 9: assertions on both sides of the boundary, not just who they are.

action_continuity.$comment: Match cut / match on action etc. from the L0 montage micro family when continuity carries the transition.

sound_lead_in_frames.$comment: Sound leads the boundary (D3 seam rule); frames before the cut at canvas fps.

mg_device.$comment: MG/UI-form transition device (fold / depth pass-through / shared-element expansion / shape morph / foreground occlusion) when the boundary change is an element-level choreography rather than a shot-level optical transition.

state_assertion.$comment: Tail/head state the transition depends on (pose, motion phase, exposure).
